title: For an etale algebra the prime below generates the maximal ideal of the local ring
statement: Let $R\to S$ be a ring map such that $\operatorname{Spec}S\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism], let $\mathfrak q\subset S$ be a prime ideal and $\mathfrak p=\mathfrak q\cap R$ its preimage in $R$. Then the ideal of the localization $S_{\mathfrak q}$ generated by the image of $\mathfrak p$ is the maximal ideal: $\mathfrak pS_{\mathfrak q}=\mathfrak qS_{\mathfrak q}$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 00U4 (lemma-etale-at-prime), item (1); used in the proof of Lemma Tag 04GN (lemma-henselization) ('since R -> S is etale, we have mS_q = qS_q')

mathlib_match.how: a few Mathlib lemmas: Spec S -> Spec R etale <-> `Algebra.Etale R S` (`HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff`, AlgebraicGeometry/Morphisms/RingHomProperties.lean:360, instance `HasRingHomProperty @Etale RingHom.Etale`, Morphisms/Etale.lean:56, and `RingHom.etale_algebraMap`, RingTheory/RingHom/Etale.lean:37); an etale algebra is formally unramified and finitely presented, hence `EssFiniteType`, and `IsUnramifiedAt R q` for every prime q (`Algebra.formallyUnramified_iff_forall`, Unramified/Locus.lean:133); then `(Algebra.isUnramifiedAt_iff_map_eq R p q).mp _ |>.2` (LocalRing.lean:134, with p = q.comap and the algebra `Localization.AtPrime p -> Localization.AtPrime q` given by `Localization.localRingHom`) is `p.map (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime q)) = maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q)`, i.e. pS_q = qS_q.
